data.narrative:
Colossal Biosciences is a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Ben Lamm and George Church, having raised $555M+ to date and currently valued at $10.32B. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 11 sector comparables: 3 public-market peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies including Chai Discovery, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Standard triangulation methods encounter material constraints. Stage-progression analysis is not applicable because the implied post-money valuation of $17.5B from a 1.7x step-up multiplier exceeds 20x total capital raised, suggesting the baseline figure is unreliable. Peer-median anchoring is not feasible due to insufficient narrow-set comparables in the same stage and valuation tier—only 2 same-stage peers exist in the broader Biotech & Health sector. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be executed because target revenue is not disclosed, though the public sector median trades at 8.1x revenue across the three identified tickers.

Given these constraints, no single triangulated valuation range can be responsibly derived from the available data. The current $10.32B posting should be treated as provisional pending either (1) auditable revenue disclosure enabling public-comp multiples, (2) access to disclosed financials from comparable private raises, or (3) resolution of the baseline valuation source. Key uncertainties center on revenue scale and the reliability of the last post-money figure.
